bodyText:
Enterprise AI Search.

Aiimi's AI search is the intelligent way to connect to knowledge at work, instantly.

Book a demo
Intuitive search, powered by AI.

Built on a scalable and secure foundation, Aiimi's platform delivers true enterprise AI search. It underpins our RAG engine, bringing semantic search, classification, LLM selection, explainability and citation, security, and full audit into a single platform – and supports integration with graph databases like Neo4j.

AI search for the modern enterprise.

Transform how people across your business work with data and AI. Aiimi starts with your entire data picture, then uses prompt analysis and contextual awareness to shrink the world down to exactly what the user needs.

Engineering.

Use real-time data discovery and knowledge management for better design and production decisions and R&D processes.

Human Resources.

Analyse and visualise employee data, for AI-driven insights into performance, engagement, and retention – enabling data-driven talent management.

Product Development.

Analyse customer feedback, market trends, and usage to feed insights into product development and ensure new products meet requirements.

Customer Support.

Empower customer service agents to ask natural language questions with GenAI, for reduced reliance on experts and faster, more accurate resolutions.

Market Intelligence.

Collate, analyse, and visualise data on market trends and competitor activity, to inform strategic decisions, spot new opportunities, and gain competitive edge.
How Enterprise AI Search works.

A typical enterprise uses hundreds of different systems, but they don't speak the same language. Aiimi’s Workplace AI platform creates a common understanding across all data sources, making it easy to find and get value from the information you already have, with built-in authentication, authorisation, and auditing.

Bring insight to life with visualisation.

Uncover connections through interactive knowledge graphs, explore results with a geospatial map view, or examine chronological relationships through data timelines. Reveal patterns, trends, and outliers at a glance, and navigate complex information with context that brings real-world relevance.

Enterprise AI you can trust.

Get all the power of AI search, with complete confidence, precision, and control.

01

Retrieve and generate the most relevant, accurate results with natural language and semantic search.

02

Get transparent, traceable AI outputs, with full explainability and citation.

03

Track model use, sentiment, accuracy, and toxicity with built-in monitoring and auditing.

04

Protect your business, with AI outputs that respect all source permissions and access controls.

05

Access web content through Aiimi's source connectors or on-demand via the AI Assistant.

06

Enhance answers derived from enterprise data with world knowledge from model memory.
